mechanism_narrative: A persistently low effective federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.3pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline by more than 1% from their 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an imminent economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.2pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC for the UNRATE effect in tightening regimes is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 800,000 units signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 800.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 420,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 420,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates a manufacturing slowdown, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment growth above 100,000 persons indicates a robust labor market, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k, or the Rank IC is below 0.04.
